snippet.title: Gravity Chaos Video Store | A VHS Tidying Game | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Gravity sent the VHS tapes flying. Now there’s a whole video store to tidy up.

In Gravity Chaos Video Store, you pick up scattered tapes, check their covers, and find the right shelf for each movie. If you’ve ever straightened a shelf that wasn’t yours, you’ll feel right at home.

Coming soon. Wishlist Gravity Chaos Video Store on Steam.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5380500/
